C1717.title: Chargebacks911 Sued by FTC for Thwarting Consumer Credit Card Disputes
C1717.summary: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission, together with the State of Florida, filed a lawsuit against Chargebacks911, alleging the company unfairly blocked consumers from disputing transactions through the credit card chargeback process. The case addresses the misuse of chargeback mechanisms to harm consumer rights.
